name: omp-agents
description: Dashboard page that tallies every omp subagent by type over a time window, charts spawns and outcomes, and opens a live transcript inspector for any running or finished run. Reads omp's own session files and stats database, read-only.
author: tommy
highlights: Tally of every omp subagent spawned, by agent type, over 1h to 30d or all time
Donut and stacked timeline charts, per-type table with OK rate, cost, tokens, median duration and models
Running-now list covering subagents and live top-level omp sessions
Live session inspector: click any run to read its transcript tail, refreshed every 3 s while it runs
Read-only: never writes to omp's session files or stats database
useCases: See which agent types omp is spawning most and how often they succeed
Watch a long-running subagent without leaving the dashboard
Attribute omp spend to agent types and models
configuration: Requires omp (the omp coding agent) with sessions under ~/.omp/agent/sessions and its stats database at ~/.omp/stats.db
Third-party apps with a backend need Settings > Security > Trusted apps turned on
Override locations with OMP_AGENTS_SESSIONS_DIR and OMP_AGENTS_STATS_DB if omp stores data elsewhere
